name: Self-healing heart valve
subtitle: a plastic heart valve that mends its cracks

effects.effect: capsules in a plastic burst when it cracks and glue the crack shut
flap valves let blood flow only one way

effect: capsules in a plastic burst when it cracks and glue the crack shut
how: Tissue heart valves wear out in 10 to 15 years, so younger patients face repeat open-heart surgery, while mechanical valves need lifelong blood thinners. These plastic leaflets flap open and shut 40 million times a year like the flaps in our veins; when a fatigue crack starts, it breaks tiny capsules that release a glue and seal it before it grows.
obstacle: Every capsule glue known so far is toxic or makes blood clot, so a blood-safe healing chemistry is still needed.
why: Plastic heart valves are in trials; none heals itself.
real: Searched for microcapsule/self-healing polymer heart valve leaflets; found only polymer-valve fatigue work and a bioresorbable valve headlined 'self-healing' without a healing mechanism.
